Simple 4-Step Process

How It Works

Getting your custom embroidered shirt from CLIP_EMBROIDARY is straightforward from start to finish.

1

Choose a Design

Pick from political designs, movie designs, IPL and other sports designs, photo embroidery, or custom text—or bring your own custom artwork.

2

Share Shirt & Design Details

Contact us on WhatsApp or phone at 7780181668 to share your design reference, placement preference, and whether you are providing the shirt or need one supplied.

3

Confirm the Price

We confirm your exact price—between ₹99 and ₹399 when you provide the shirt, plus any additional shirt cost if we supply the shirt based on quality.

4

Arrange Stitching & Delivery

Once confirmed, we stitch your custom embroidery onto the shirt and coordinate convenient door delivery anywhere across Telangana.
